title: Daily Check-In
description: Log your mood, stress level, and urge intensity to stay mindful.
easyVersion: Rate only your mood and urge intensity on a simple scale.

title: Notice One Trigger
description: Identify and write down one emotion or situation that prompted an urge today.

title: Read Your 'Why' Aloud
description: Revisit your personal commitment and speak your reasons with conviction.

title: Phone-Free Walk
description: Step outside for a peaceful 5-minute walk without looking at your screen.

title: Acknowledge a Win
description: Give yourself credit for one positive, intentional choice you made today.

title: Clean Sweep
description: Delete risky apps, enable web filters, and charge your phone away from bed.

title: Sleep Anchor
description: Head to bed at your designated sleep time to protect your willpower reserve.
easyVersion: Start wind-down within 30 minutes of your target sleep time.

title: Digital Sunset
description: Put your phone and screens away at least 30 minutes before sleep.

title: Morning Sunlight & Water
description: Drink a full glass of water and get 5 minutes of morning light.

title: Plan Tomorrow's Top 3
description: Write down tomorrow's 3 most meaningful tasks before ending your day.

title: Make Your Bed
description: Complete your first small discipline win right after waking up.

title: Circadian Rhythm Lock
description: Maintain your target sleep time on at least 5 out of 7 nights.

title: The 10-Minute Delay
description: Pause for 10 full minutes before giving in to a minor impulse or craving.
easyVersion: Pause and take 5 deep breaths before acting on an impulse.

title: Breathing Practice
description: Run through one full session with the Ember SOS breathing circle.

title: Urge Inspection
description: Rate an urge from 1 to 5 and write down where in your body you felt it.

title: 10-Pushup Physical Reset
description: Break psychological rumination with a sudden burst of 10 pushups.

title: Share Progress
description: Confide your streak or effort with a trusted friend or mentor.

title: Wave Rider
description: Successfully surf and overcome 3 separate urges using the SOS tool.

title: 15-Minute Movement
description: Re-energize your dopamine and muscles with 15 minutes of brisk exercise.
easyVersion: Take a gentle 7-minute stroll or light stretching.

title: Hourly Stretch
description: Stand up and stretch your chest, spine, and legs during a work block.

title: Squat & Pushup Combo
description: Complete 20 controlled squats followed by 10 pushups.

title: Outdoor Oxygen
description: Take a 20-minute walk outside in nature or fresh air.

title: Take the Stairs
description: Avoid all elevators and escalators for the entire day.

title: Body Armor
description: Complete your physical movement session on at least 4 days this week.

title: Urge Audit
description: Log every urge with its exact time, surroundings, and precursor mood.
easyVersion: Log at least one urge and tag its primary trigger.

title: Write an If-Then Plan
description: Craft an explicit response: 'If [trigger occurs], then I will [constructive action]'.

title: Analyze Past Patterns
description: Review yesterday's logs to uncover hidden emotional or temporal habits.

title: Sanitize Environment
description: Remove one physical or digital cue from your bedroom or desk.

title: Accountability Share
description: Send your latest if-then plan to an ally or accountability partner.

title: Trigger Map Blueprint
description: Build your personalized trigger map with 5 comprehensive if-then plans.

title: Danger Time Replacement
description: Substitute old habits with a pre-planned healthy activity during danger hours.
easyVersion: Engage in any simple distractor for 10 minutes during danger hours.

title: Creative Spark
description: Practice an engaging hobby for 15 minutes (drawing, instrument, coding, cooking).

title: Curiosity Learning
description: Read an inspiring article, book chapter, or learn a skill for 15 minutes.

title: Tidy Micro-Zone
description: Declutter and wipe down one small area of your living or work space.

title: Tomorrow's Script
description: Pre-decide your exact danger-time diversion for tomorrow evening.

title: Habit Transmutation
description: Execute your replacement ritual on at least 5 of 7 days.

title: 3-Minute Resonant Breathing
description: Lower cortisol with 3 minutes of measured, slow diaphragmatic breathing.
easyVersion: Take 1 minute of conscious slow breathing.

title: 3-Line Journal
description: Write three honest sentences about your thoughts or emotions right now.

title: Celebrate 3 Wins
description: Record three small victories from your week, however subtle.

title: Quiet Stillness
description: Sit comfortably in silence for 10 minutes without screens or headphones.

title: Gratitude Anchor
description: Name 3 specific things you are genuinely grateful for today.

title: Mindful Journaler
description: Maintain your emotional awareness journal on at least 6 out of 7 days.

title: Real-World Connection
description: Reach out to a family member, friend, or colleague via message or phone.
easyVersion: Send a warm check-in text to one friend.

title: Re-Anchor Your 'Why'
description: Reflect deeply on how your identity has shifted over these 8 weeks.

title: Letter to Future Self
description: Pen an honest, encouraging letter to your future self when times get tough.

title: Act of Kindness
description: Perform an intentional, unprompted act of kindness for someone else.

title: Offline Invitation
description: Invite someone to meet in person for coffee, exercise, or a walk.

title: Stage 1 Boss: The Danger-Zone Gauntlet
description: Document your comprehensive danger-time protocol and hold the line for 48 consecutive hours.
